title: Invoice aging report
body:
Finance wants an aging report for unpaid invoices.

Add `aging_report()` to `parcelo/reports.py`. It returns a dict with the keys "0-30", "31-60" and "60+". Each value is the total amount of the open invoices whose age, in whole days since they were issued, falls in that bucket: 0 to 30 days, 31 to 60 days, and more than 60 days. Paid invoices are left out, and a bucket with no invoices totals zero.

`days_between` in `parcelo/legacy/billing.py` already has the day arithmetic.
